fields.description:
_Confirm with WagerTech (Emily/Lina) which Deal fields must be snapshotted onto a Sign-Up at completion, and which Deal fields can change over a Deal's lifecycle and need dated history. Feeds directly into DECISION-07 and the Commercial Terms history object design._

## Why this matters

* Sign-Up payout reporting must reflect the commercial terms in effect when the Sign-Up completed, not the Deal's current values

* Not yet a fixed field list — needs WagerTech confirmation

* Design for the Deal / Commercial Terms history object is blocked on this list

* Flagged as the priority blocker for that design work

## What needs confirming with WagerTech

* Which Deal fields must be captured as a snapshot on the Sign-Up record at completion
* Which Deal fields can change during a Deal's lifecycle and need dated history (versioned Deal vs. related Commercial Terms object)
* Whether backdating a changed term needs to recompute already-completed Sign-Ups

* A real example already occurred: a CPA change was backdated 10 days into the month

## Field list to validate (updated from live Deal page, 2026-09-11)

* Payout Model — how commission is calculated (e.g. CPA vs. Rev Share)

* Commercial Terms section

* Currency

* Commercial Terms section — currency changes are handled as a new Deal, not tracked on this one

* Monthly Cap

* Commercial Terms section

* Deposit Range Min / Deposit Range Max / Deposit Range

* Commercial Terms section — three separate fields on the page, unclear if Deposit Range duplicates Min/Max or is distinct

* Avg Deposit Target

* Commercial Terms section

* Qualifying Action

* Commercial Terms section

* Redeposit Required

* Redeposit Details section

* Effective Start Date / Effective End Date

* Additional Details section

* CPA Amount

## Open gap — CPA

* CPA / commission rate is not a visible field anywhere in the Commercial Terms section on the live Deal page (confirmed via screenshot of ON-HARDROCK-C-CASINO-WT, 2026-09-11)

* Need to confirm with WagerTech whether it lives on the Admin tab, is derived from Payout Model, or is tracked at the Deal Rep Assignment level instead
* This must be resolved before the field list goes final — CPA is the term referenced most in the commercial-terms discussion

## Notes

* Blocks DECISION-07 and the Commercial Terms history object design.

## Source

* [Wagertech Weekly Sync doc — Sep 11, 2026 entry, "Commercial terms capturing" action items](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1K1r0RugHIbFMuEO6ISWMXF7-SUOg1Vi7KNhWWE_idGI/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.d9ppac9j5lqh)
* [Sep 11, 2026 Weekly Sync transcript — Emily Vandenberg & Joyce Kiddell discuss which fields could change (CPA, caps, deposit range, average deposit, payout model), \~20:31](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nTJh6ZZT4bAu8E6I6QFypOcrIn1cpg9S2mVd6ayZsrk/edit?tab=t.72ttakve44h3)
* Live Deal record screenshot (ON-HARDROCK-C-CASINO-WT), reviewed 2026-09-11 — source of the corrected field list above
* Owner: Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-09-11 from Sep 11 Weekly Sync review, per Kobi Kunasekaran's directive. Updated same day against the live Deal layout.
